I brought over your Rainbow Rave mod for x.com and added extras made for this page. It's a new mod here, **Rainbow Rave**, and it's working now. I checked it in screenshots and it threw no errors.

**From the x.com version:**
- The rolling rainbow background with white text.
- The trance loop you made with code, so no sound files.
- The page zooms with the kick drum.
- The play/pause and zoom buttons in the bottom right.

**New for this page:**
- 🕶️ **The robot** keeps changing colour and glowing. When the music starts it drops on a pair of shades, then head-bangs on every kick, tilting side to side.
- 🌊 **The title** waves letter by letter and shimmers through colours.
- 🔦 **Lasers:** two fans of white beams sweep up from the bottom corners and flash on each kick.
- 🌈 **Buttons:** "Get it" is a moving rainbow, and GitHub gets a rainbow ring.
- 🎶 **The track builds up:** six bars of full groove, a breakdown bar (the lasers dim and the kick drops out), then a bar of speeding-up snare with a rising whoosh. Then **the drop**: a crash, a white flash, the robot does a flip, and rainbow sparks burst out of it.
